caveat: UNVERIFIED Class B (expert recall). Not Class A. Promote only with owner-uploaded artefacts.

cases.title: Fire pump test-line-to-tank (invalid flow cert)
cases.effect: Flow certificate is invalid. Verdict FAIL for statutory / CD pack. Not Class A.
cases.required_remediation: Witness a duty-point test that proves flow into the system, not recirculation to the tank.

cases.title: Covers/clips left on — nameplate unreadable
cases.effect: Cannot assign Class A. Unprovable if the photo is the only remaining evidence.
cases.required_remediation: Remove covers/clips; photograph serial, duty, impeller stamp; complete labelling.

cases.title: Certificate serial ≠ register serial
cases.required_remediation: Reconcile register or re-test the installed pump.

cases.title: Factory test older than 12 months with no site witness
cases.required_remediation: Site flow test witnessed by independent Cx — not to tank.

cases.title: GRMS certificate ≠ live configuration
cases.effect: UNPROVABLE room readiness at room-by-room scale.
cases.required_remediation: Diff cert room list against live controller map; remap before M12 gate.

cases.title: Never infer integrated function from individual tests
cases.effect: UNPROVABLE occupancy. Unit-test green is not a C&E pass.
